mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% for two consecutive months signals the Federal Reserve's impending tightening, which raises discount rates and dampens equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains above for ≥2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified tightening window (t-test p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not sustain the >0.3% level for ≥2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates wage growth outpacing productivity, which raises labor costs for firms and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above previous month by >0.5% and remains above for ≥3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negatively correlated with PAYEMS wage acceleration (Pearson ρ < -0.1), or the wage acceleration pattern reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in HOUST industrial production exceeding 2% from the prior month, sustained for two months, reflects strengthening economic demand that boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above prior month by >2% and remains above for ≥2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the identified demand surge (t-test p > 0.05), or HOUST does not sustain the >2% increase.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO supply index of at least 4% over two months suggests tight supply conditions, which raises input costs and compresses profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥4% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the identified supply contraction (t-test p > 0.05), or INDPRO recovers before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for any month during a period of elevated unemployment (UNRATE < 5%), the higher policy rate increases borrowing costs and reduces equity discounting, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% AND UNRATE is below 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not negatively correlated with the policy rate increase (Pearson ρ > -0.2) during qualifying months, or UNRATE rises above 5% before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4% for three consecutive months suggests a cooling labor market, lowering wage growth expectations and reducing equity risk premia, which tends to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and remains below for ≥3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the identified cooling period (t-test p > 0.05), or UNRATE does not sustain the decline.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive rise in RSAFS retail sales exceeding 3% indicates strengthening consumer demand, which elevates earnings expectations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS crosses above prior month by >3% and remains above for ≥2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the identified demand surge (t-test p > 0.05), or RSAFS does not sustain the >3% increase.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls by at least 2% for three consecutive months while HOUST rises by at least 1% in the same window, it signals a supply-demand imbalance favoring inflationary pressures, which tends to depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by ≥2% for 3 consecutive months AND HOUST rises by ≥1% in the same months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the identified imbalance window (t-test p > 0.05), or the pattern reverses before the horizon.
